Opening-line file moves far more than expectedThe 2021 opening-line file implies a mean open→close move of 3.40 points, roughly double what is normally reported. The file names a single book (WSGT) but carries no capture timestamp, so it is unclear whether these are true openers.
No strategy — the figure is reported for transparency and used by no strategy

Two extreme closing spreadsClosing spreads of 24 (New England, 2007) and 27 (Denver, 2013) exceed the guardrail used in the integrity check. Both rows are internally consistent (result/total identities hold) and are historically plausible blowout lines. Retained; not externally confirmed.
9 rows in the extreme-lines review list

Model specification was chosen on early dataThe two feature sets were selected once using 2003–2014 walk-forward RMSE only, then applied unchanged to every later season. Betting results from 2015 onward were therefore not part of the selection decision.
